manifest.title: 2d-rotation / patterned showcase construction
limitations: Only recorder-mediated deliveries, commands and saved boundaries are observed; direct function calls, unwrapped commands and unsaved editor states are excluded.
Design notes are explicit author annotations, not internal reasoning.

details.label: Official question, choices, answer and explanation

details.observation: The source upper-left pair is horizontal; C keeps that cell and turns the pair vertical.

design.inference: Decide whether pip rows travel and turn with their cells.
design.condition: Several directional tiles share counts with their locally reoriented copies.
design.foil: Keeping the right counts while rotating individual groups separately looks nearly legal.
design.evidence: Ignore pip axes and require at least two matches, then restore axes to isolate one.
